He has just tipped back his ivory Panama hat adorned with a vivid tropical parrot feather, his head thrown back in a raw, boisterous, open-mouthed belly laugh of complete arrogance and unbridled wealth, his eyes crinkling with ruthless joy. Clamped firmly between his teeth is a thick, fat, smoldering Dominican tobacco cigar, a glowing orange ember visible at the tip, sending a delicate spiral of blue-grey smoke curling lazily past his weathered cheekbones and mingling with the bright golden sunlight. He pushes a vintage candy-apple red gas-powered lawnmower whose side discharge chute is blasting an explosive, high-pressure volcanic geyser of crisp United States one-hundred-dollar bills straight into the azure sky. Thousands of green banknotes rain down in chaotic vortexes, catching blinding sunlight glints and casting intricate shadows across the grass. Flanking him in the air, the slate-blue alien leaps dynamically, clad in an oversized vintage black-and-gold #99 mesh football jersey and baggy distressed denim jorts, draped in three massive diamond-encrusted Cuban chains that swing with kinetic force. The alien’s face is contorted in manic, euphoric drill hype, eyes wild, mouth wide open in a silent scream of greed, multi-jointed fingers grasping wildly at the airborne currency. Deep in the soft-focus, creamy background on a distant sidewalk, the blurred silhouette of an elderly sunburnt man on an electric mobility scooter glides quietly past, completely unfazed by the madness. Saturated Kodachrome color profile, dramatic backlighting illuminating translucent green paper currency, extreme textural detail of linen fabrics, metallic chains, glowing cigar ember, and individual grass blades, photorealistic 8k resolution.

metadata.prompt: A jaw-dropping, wide-angle cinematic 35mm film still capturing an outrageously absurd consumerist spectacle deep inside the cavernous aisles of a massive suburban big-box warehouse wholesale supermarket. Dominating the entire interior space, an authentic, gargantuan sixty-foot-wide metallic extraterrestrial flying saucer UFO spacecraft is crammed impossibly between structural steel pillars and collapsing industrial merchandise shelves. The brushed-titanium saucer disk is heavy with industrial welds, glowing cyan anti-gravity thrusters along its rim, and hydraulic landing struts that have crushed pallets of bulk soda packs and cereal boxes across the polished concrete floor. Fluorescent warehouse strip lights flicker overhead, casting cold specular highlights across the polished alien metal. Comically pinned to the saucer's outer hull are giant fluorescent-yellow retail sale price tags reading "CLEARANCE ASST. SPACECRAFT - 99¢". Standing in the sharp foreground beside the landed craft, the 68-year-old East Asian mob boss inspects the vehicle like a discerning grocer choosing ripe produce: he is dressed in a tailored retro 1950s two-tone pastel-pink and black bowling shirt, pressed high-waisted pleated beige slacks, and two-tone wingtip oxford leather shoes, with tortoiseshell reading glasses perched low on his nose. His lips are clamped tightly shut in a calculating, stoic line, completely devoid of any cigars, cigarettes, or smoke; in one ring-covered hand, he carries a tiny red plastic supermarket handheld basket containing a single green apple, while in the other he taps a small brass inspection hammer against the flying saucer’s thermal tiles to check its build quality. Perched atop the glowing glass dome cockpit of the giant UFO, the slender slate-blue alien squats in an aggressive drill posture, wearing an oversized distressed charcoal-grey heavyweight streetwear hoodie and tactical cargo trousers. The alien screams in manic, victorious street ecstasy, head thrown back to flash a bespoke full set of liquid-chrome mirror-polished drill grillz over sharp teeth, four dilated vertical slit pupils burning with chaotic joy as its long multi-jointed fingers throw intricate hip-hop gang signs toward the ceiling surveillance cameras. On the far right edge of the frame, a stunned retail checkout cashier in a blue apron stands with an expression of existential dread, holding a tiny red barcode scanner gun pointed aimlessly at the colossal spaceship hull. Cinematic deep-focus composition, high-contrast industrial lighting, realistic atmospheric dust motes floating in fluorescent shafts, hyper-detailed metal textures, peeling stickers, and 1970s documentary film grain, photorealistic 8k resolution.

Behind the windshield, the elderly 68-year-old Asian driver commands the frame, dressed in a retro crimson-red crushed velvet tracksuit, a reversed black tumbled leather newsboy cap, and oversized amber-tinted aviator glasses. The alien holds a customized, pastel-pink tactical AK-pattern rifle, the barrel of which is adorned with intertwined tropical hibiscus flowers. Continuous streams of high-pressure neon pink water jets and iridescent, floating bubbles blast outward from the muzzle, refracting the harsh Florida sunlight into miniature rainbow spectrums. The alien exhibits a wild, tongue-out manic drill rap sneer, its neck muscles flexed in rhythmic hype. The background presents towering royal palm trees, pastel Art Deco architectural facades, and clear cobalt skies, all warped dramatically by the severe barrel distortion of an 8mm fisheye lens. The foreground street shows detailed asphalt textures, rubber skid trails, and wet splashes reflecting the blue sky. metadata.prompt:
以 @图片1 这张机械霸王龙得来速场景图为底图，保持原有画面构图、角色、机械霸王龙、外星生物、得来速窗口和鱼眼镜头质感完全不变，在其基础上设计成一张嘻哈 drill 音乐风格的电影/单曲封面海报，叠加中英文标题文字与街头视觉元素。

【关键排版要求：文字绝对不能遮挡人物】
- 骑在机械霸王龙背上的爷爷位于画面中上方，他的头部和身体区域必须完全留白、不被任何文字覆盖。
- 主标题中文「退休爷爷的帮派生活」改为放在画面最顶部的天空区域，做成横向通栏但整体上移、缩小字号并压缩字高，紧贴画面上边缘，确保标题底边在爷爷头顶以上，不压住他的帽子和头。
- 英文主标题「RETIRED OG LIFE」全部大写，放在画面最底部、警戒线胶带上方的空白地面区域（画面下沿），横向排布，同样不得遮挡爷爷、外星生物和霸王龙头部。
- 左上角保留小号标签「DIRTY SOUTH DRILL」，右上角保留「FLORIDA · 2026」，均放在天空空白处。

字体风格：
- 中文使用粗粝厚重的 drill 风格字体，做磨损、做旧、轻微故障错位效果，白字配黑色描边和暗红投影。
- 英文使用尖锐棱角的 condensed 哥特/粗黑字体，带斜切与滴血做旧细节。

drill 嘻哈点缀元素（只放在边缘和空白处，不遮挡主体角色与爷爷）：
- 左下角「PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT」脏标，轻微卷边磨损。
- 底部黄黑警戒线胶带斜贴；左右下角少量红色喷漆涂鸦 tag。
- 弹孔、裂纹、墨迹飞溅、噪点颗粒、VHS 扫描线、红色暗角，主要分布在四周边缘。
- 局部暗红与荧光青色霓虹光晕，呼应机械龙的青色光效；整体高对比、硬朗街头混音带封面质感。

保持电影感与 35mm 胶片颗粒，文字与装饰融合自然，像专业说唱单曲封面，16:9 横版，高清。
